notes.title: Main Update 11-29-2022: Face and Cleanup
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/0af3edf68a533106cec45285feeced40e6dc935a.gif[/img]

We're in the processes of adding new features to ViRo Live Studio.  This build lays the foundation for those updates.  We also fixed a number of bugs including the mute toggle not working and the face expressions not responding.

notes.title: Big Update - More Motion Capture, More Stability!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/d1093b2ee1ed9e4a6f03b5035240cfcd770782b5.gif[/img]
[h2]ViRo Live Studio now natively supports:[/h2]
[list]
[*] OptiTrack
[*] Perception Neuron
[*] Hybrid VR Rigs
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/4cc6dd341e159436eab772475f497bf8ddc340b0.png[/img]

[h2]Hybrid VR Rigs[/h2]
A Hybrid VR rig is when you use a VR headset and it's controllers that are not tracked by basestations (EX: Oculus), but you use Vive Trackers for legs and chest tracking (which do require basestations).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/8f91a80115fd3e2fc62d0878d754c7bb0a323757.jpg[/img]

This is tricky because each VR system has their own coordinate systems so the vive trackers wouldn't know their position in relation to the VR headset. We've developed a system to align the different tracking methods. That said, depending on how you put on your chest tracking, it might put your head on backwards. We have a button to fix that just-in-case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/e2b44c51e5fe2eb9cfc49c30a64039313d4b61bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fixed Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Muscle Smoothing
[*] VRM Avatar List now sorting properly
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/7cd1221a77fc27be936a3f9692f81affb4eec350.png[/img]

[h2]Desktop Mode has the following changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The VR headset now displays dim text informing the user that VR rendering was disabled
[*] You can force Desktop Mode off by using ~SetActiveState "Desktop_Mode" false~
[*] A message will display at start if you have desktop mode set to ON with a button to disable it
[*] Desktop Mode toggle moved from Face Tracking selection to Main Menu Settings
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/ac739f51dc2e96ee362f4ac721da0f3591382ae2.png[/img]

notes.title: Public Beta (super small) 9-11-2022: Desktop Mode removed until improved
notes.content: Desktop Mode has been disabled for now until I can make it better.  All it did was disable VR rendering but kept the HMD active.  This was handy for instances when you needed the HMD active for hand controller tracking.

notes.title: Public Beta Update - 8-24-2022: XXXPress Yourself with text bubble commands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/30e4ef2c3fe2919a308a88306d8cb56b71526800.jpg[/img]

Try out the new console command
TextEmote “text”

TextEmote "Oooohhhh!!!" style:speech time:10.0 size:1 speaker:head
TextEmote "Oooohhhh!!!" style:inverted time:10.0 speaker:crotch

required
	"text string"

optional
	style:speech,inverted
	speaker:head,crotch
	time:float
	size:float

Example:
[b]TextEmote "Hello World!" style:speech speaker:head size:0.0 time:5.0[/b]

We'll be expanding functionality of this in the near future but feel free to try it out.

notes.title: Main Update 7-29-2022: All the things!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/d5a7ad9248f3bc353907ee9d8394fd4fbb667fa7.png[/img]

[h1]Here is a list of the new features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Calibration now has better instructions and another method to calibrate
[*]  Standard Shader now has support for any bundle made from any version of Unity 2019
[*]  Pose mode feature added.  This allows you to pose your avatar any way you like.  Great for photos or getting your character ready when only streaming with head tracking (EX:  ViRo Live Face Portal for iOS)
[*]  VRMs can now import without a thumbnail
[*]  New tutorial section leading people to find more resources as needed
[*]  Bend Goals added to pose mode for IK adjustments
[*]  Fingers now reset on UI button in Pose Mode
[*]  Hall of Mirrors Bug in VR mode fixed
[*]  Skybox support added when exporting / loading a bundle
[*]  Default Pose added to Pose Mode
[*]  Vive Pro Eye and Vive Face Tracking mode now work with custom avatars (VRM and non-VRM)
[*]  Getting out of menus is faster for people wanting to use Pose Mode
[*]  Fullscreen toggle added in Settings
[*]  Help and Tutorials now point to online guides for addition resources
[*]  VSF support added.  Place VSF avatars in ViRo Live Studio\User Assets\Asset Bundles\... (Not all plugins supported)
[*]  VR head tracking in roomscale no longer breaks neck
[*]  Shoulder Rotation Weight: Adjust how much your shoulders follow your arm movement
[*]  Left / Right Arm Swivel: Adjust the rotation of your arms and how they bend
[*]  VR Tracking Scale: Have all tracked objects move closer or further away from each other
[*]  VR Tracking Height: Adjust the VR Floor Level
[*]  Avatar Scale: Range Adjusted from 0.7 - 1.3 to 0.5 - 1.5
[*]  Quivering motion bug fixed
[*]  Fixed some UI ghost input bugs
[*]  Slider that scales tracking space, to help with some avatar proportions
[*]  Buttons that offset the tracking space, to help with some avatar proportions
[*]  Shoulder slider to help with some avatars
[*]  Elbow bend swivel sliders added
[*]  Fixed some elbow and knee twitching
[/list]

Thats a pretty big list ^_^!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/258d0a334d7444b245edda82b89bf1c8c88f5de3.png[/img]
[h3]Shoulder adjustment options[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/0db143a5f9dd326ada075dc21eaec8c5fd684f10.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pose Mode:[/h1]
Pose mode is used to Pose your Avatar.  This is great for taking screenshots or posing your avatar for simple streams that only use lip sync and/or head tracking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/ccf462107426353819938eac8a4fea011f04dfb7.gif[/img]
[h2]Controls:[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Press the right mouse button and hold it to rotate around your avatar.
[*]  Use the middle mouse button to pan.
[*]  Left click is used for moving and rotating various gizmos to assist in posing your avatar.
[*]  Press the F key on your keyboard to focus on your avatar.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/f5899ba9ac2ced87028bd3c8a0efb3faf75f5276.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/8fb31c0c388e32bf4abf609e47a66e4eefb4da33.png[/img]

notes.title: Public Beta 7-29-2022: The Perfect Fit
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/258d0a334d7444b245edda82b89bf1c8c88f5de3.png[/img]
We've added some spiffy new controls to assist you in making your avatar move exactly how you want.

[list]
[*]Shoulder Rotation Weight:  Adjust how much your shoulders follow your arm movement
[*]Left / Right Arm Swivel:  Adjust the rotation of your arms and how they bend
[*]VR Tracking Scale:  Have all tracked objects move closer or further away from each other
[*]VR Tracking Height:  Adjust the VR Floor Level
[*]Avatar Scale:  Range Adjusted from 0.7 - 1.3 to 0.5 - 1.5
[*]Quivering motion bug fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Public Beta: 7-22-2-22 Twisted Neck Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/0db143a5f9dd326ada075dc21eaec8c5fd684f10.jpg[/img]
A long long time ago, we tested full body tracking within VR.  Our space was limited so we didn't notice anything amiss!

Many days pass and we're back to testing.  All of the sudden, my avatars neck breaks !  All I did was turn around!

The moral of the story is, don't leave AR Kit head tracking scripts running when using VR for head tracking.

Checkbox fixed.

The end

notes.title: Public Beta Update: 7-20-2022 - Hall of Mirrors / VSF / Pose Mode / Vive Face
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565882/ccf462107426353819938eac8a4fea011f04dfb7.gif[/img]
Big list today
[list]
[*]Hall of Mirrors Bug in VR mode fixed
[*]Skybox support added when exporting / loading bundle
[*]Pose mode had many fixes applied and a default pose added
[*]Vive Pro Eye and Vive Face Tracking mode now work with custom avatars (VRM and non-VRM)
[*]Getting out of menus is faster for people wanting to use Pose Mode
[*]Fullscreen toggle added in Settings
[*]Help and Tutorials now point to online guides for additional resources
[/list]

VSF only works right now by putting the .vsfavatar file in the path
ViRo Live Studio\User Assets\Asset Bundles\...
and using the load toggle in the Bundles->User Bundles tabs to activate and deactivate the character
Not all supported plugins for VSF are supported.  Plugin whitelist will be coming soon in the guides.

We'll be testing this build for a public full release in the next day or two before moving to new features.
